description: Meaning-only search: ranks deployments by embedding similarity to the query, ignoring exact words. Use it when keyword search finds little because records use other words for the same idea, for example 'software that reads contracts and flags risky clauses'. To compare a fuller use case description, optionally within an industry, country or provider, prefer find_similar_usecases. Each result has a Similarity score from 0 to 1, Url (the original source) and HubUrl (its hub page).

limit.description: Maximum results requested. Public previews return at most 3; personal-key access permits up to 20.

query.description: What you are looking for, in plain words.

name: vector_search_usecases
title: Search AI deployments by meaning
